title: Polygon — Asymmetric Quantile Fan
note: val-v1 · logreg-v2 · Bands are expanding quantiles of the residual, so the fan is allowed to be lopsided and it is: the upside band sits further from the fit than the downside one. Price has spent most of its record ABOVE the least-squares line — an expanding fit lags a rising trend by construction, and that is a property of the method rather than a valuation signal.
subtitle: 95th band is 13.0× the fit · 5th band is 1/7.7 of it
